title.narrative: Waste processing plants (CASH IT and New End Market) established and operational

description.narrative: As part of the project activities, the ASASE Foundation is expected to establish waste processing plants that will reprocess plastic waste delivered by the collection centers. This result focuses on the establishment and the operationalisation of these plants.

title.narrative: Number of CASH IT and New End Market recycling plants established, launched and operational.

description.narrative: A key measure to achieving the impact of the project is the establishment of waste processing plants that will be used to reprocess plastic waste collected from the communities and the streets. This indicator, therefore, tracks the establishment and operationalization of the plants. It will also assess the functionality of the plants to determine whether they are performing up to the optimum level, in terms of waste expected to be processed on monthly basis.

comment.narrative: Documentation on the establishment of the plants will be reviewed.

title.narrative: Reduced Plastic packaging litter on the streets in Accra (expansion from KponeKatamanso to 2 other local municipalities within Greater Accra Region)

description.narrative: This result focuses on implementing measures that will enhance the knowledge of the populace in the implementing communities to adapt to best waste management practices.

title.narrative: % of people in beneficiary communities who reported on reduced plastic waste on the streets and in their communities

description.narrative: This indicator focuses on the extent to which people in the beneficiary communities have adapted best waste management practices and how it has helped in reducing plastic waste in the communities. The indicator, therefore, measures the extent to which the project has contributed to reducing plastic waste in the beneficiary communities.

comment.narrative: A survey will be conducted in the beneficiary communities including schools to collect data to assess the achievement of the target. Focus group discussions will also be held with some community members and key stakeholders of the project to assess the contribution of the project towards reduced plastics in the beneficiary communities

title.narrative: Improved waste management practices among school children and residents of beneficiary communities in Accra (expansion from KponeKatamanso to 2 other local municipalities within Greater Accra Region)

description.narrative: Under this result, the project will focus on educating the general public, including school children about best waste management practices in the beneficiary communities. The education is expected to enhance the knowledge of the populace so that they can adapt best waste management and segregation practices in their households, and communities and schools.

title.narrative: % of households who are practicing effective waste segregation and waste management

description.narrative: This measures the degree to which the tenets of the project has permeated through residents in the beneficiary communities.

comment.narrative: A baseline survey was conducted to assess the waste management and segregation practices among households in the beneficiary communities. The survey explored how households dispose of their waste the extent to which they practice waste segregation as well as challenges that hinders the implementation of best waste management practices in communities.

Survey and focus group discussions will be conducted at the end of the project to assess the extent to which the project has contributed to effective waste management among members of the beneficiary communities.

comment.narrative: Sustainable employment creation is a key goal of this project this indicator seeks to analyze the employment generated by the project.

Survey will be carried out among the group of persons employed directly and indirectly by the project such as waste pickers administrative staff and factory workers to ascertain the impact of the project on their livelihoods through the employment opportunities offered to them by the project.

The project collected employment data for persons who are directly employed by ASASE as well as those working in the CASH IT plants. The employment data also include the waste pickers who constitute the indirect employees of the project.

description.narrative: SDG 8 Decent Work and Economic GrowthFor more information about the GE RF methodological notes please check https://europa.eu/capacity4dev/eurfi

comment.narrative: Sustainable employment creation is a key goal of this project this indicator seeks to analyze the employment generated by the project.

Survey will be carried out among the group of persons employed directly and indirectly by the project such as waste pickers administrative staff and factory workers to ascertain the impact of the project on their livelihoods through the employment opportunities offered to them by the project.

The project collected employment data for persons who are directly employed by ASASE as well as those working in the CASH IT plants. The employment data also include the waste pickers who constitute the indirect employees of the project.

title.narrative: % of waste pickers (disaggregated by sex) who reported on improved knowledge in waste segregation and management

description.narrative: To improve the efficiency of the waste management process pickers are key in the value chain, their efforts disaggregating litter are key to attaining efficiency in the value chain. The project team planned to train waste pickers in waste segregation and management methods. This indicator, therefore, measures the level of knowledge of waste pickers in waste management and segregation.

comment.narrative: Questionnaires will be administered to the waste pickers after the training sessions to assess the extent to which the training enhanced their knowledge of different waste segregation methods. Following this a survey will be conducted 6 months after the training to assess the extent to which the waste pickers are implementing the knowledge acquired from the training.
